svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Hoàng Đình Sáng, Meoki online. I build quiet, useful software for the things I love: Japanese, light novels, and interfaces that feel alive. Designer since 2016, security graduate, full-stack engineer by day. After hours I learn Japanese, read from a tsundoku pile that never gets shorter, and open-source the tools I wanted for my own reading.
